d:
Sometimes, one moment can change the course of a dog's life. At Villalobos Rescue Center, Tia Torres and her team meet pit bulls and vulnerable strays whose futures hang in the balance. Whether they are recovering from injuries, overcoming difficult pasts or struggling to trust people again, these dogs need someone willing to give them a chance. And for some, a single rescue becomes the beginning of a completely different life.
Watch Pit Bulls & Parolees, Season 7, Episodes 5, 8 and 9; Season 8, Episodes 1, 8, 9 and 10, on Animal Planet India.
